data.name: Trees Inc
data.detailed_description:
Start small. Grow endlessly. Chop. Earn. Expand.

Turn effort into automation.

Hire workers to cut and regrow trees, transforming every action into a system that keeps producing — even when you stop.

Watch the numbers climb.

Upgrades stack, multipliers compound, and every decision pushes your production further. Small gains become exponential growth.

Break the loop.

Prestige resets your progress, but unlocks permanent power. Come back faster, stronger, and ready to scale even harder.

• Classic incremental “numbers go up” progression

• From manual play to full idle automation

• Compounding upgrades and exponential scaling

• Prestige system with long-term progression

• Unlock perks using XP to power your progression

data.short_description: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)/Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD Phenom II X2 550
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)/Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 5100 or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard built-in audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (2018 or later)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard built-in audio

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (with Mesa drivers)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent (with Mesa drivers)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible sound card
